proxyPrivacy.message: Choose a proxy you trust: its operator receives routed destinations and connection metadata. HTTP content can be read; HTTPS content stays protected by TLS. HTTP/SOCKS proxy links do not encrypt metadata. Settings stay on this device; proxy login is not supported.

invalidProxySettings.message: Enter a valid proxy server and a port from 1 to 65535.

proxySetupNotificationFailureMessage.message: This page could not be reached and no proxy is configured. Choose the bundled gateway or your own proxy to enable selective routing.

onboardingText.message: A working proxy is required. Use one you already operate, or download our ready-to-install ByeDPI helper from GitHub. Choose and save below. Ordinary browsing stays direct.

gatewayInstallSteps.message: Download the GitHub project ZIP and extract it. Run helper/install.cmd as administrator. Save the bundled gateway option, then check again until the status is ready.

gatewayRemoveSteps.message: To remove the helper, first turn the extension off or select another proxy. From the extracted project folder, run helper/uninstall.cmd as administrator. Removing the Chrome extension alone does not remove Windows services. If the folder is gone, download and extract the project again.
